material.text: Five clean waves up from Jul 17 to Sep 9 (+71%, wave 1). The pullback is under the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (+14% to +3.7%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the Jun 11 low and the 61.8% retracement of the Jul 17–Sep 9 rise in the same place.
